overview.en:
Connect WRITER’s official MCP for content generation, translation, file processing and knowledge graph workflows.

Prepare content from a defined brief and available knowledge or files. Keep intended audience, tone, and source material explicit when drafting or translating.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接 WRITER 官方 MCP，进行内容生成、翻译、文件处理和知识图谱工作。

根据明确简报与可用知识或文件准备内容，起草或翻译时说明目标读者、语气与来源材料。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Draft an article from this brief and the supplied reference material.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据这份简报与提供的参考资料起草文章。

starterPrompts.en: Translate this content while preserving terminology and tone.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 翻译这段内容，同时保留术语与语气。

starterPrompts.en: Review this draft against the available knowledge and improve clarity.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 依据可用知识审查这份草稿，并提高可读性。
